comment: Accessibility issues axe finds on the site today, by build (project), page (route), rule id and selector. test/a11y/smoke.spec.ts reports each one and does not fail on it. The full axe sweep in step 32 (WS01 acceptance criterion 1) fixes them and empties this list; nothing new may be added to it. On / today: the muted grey date and place lines in the upcoming events and clubs lists are below 4.5:1 (color-contrast), and the hero slideshow's dots are smaller than 24 by 24 px (target-size, WCAG 2.2). The slideshow moves on every 5 seconds, so whichever dot is current is listed as .w-5 and the others by label; all six forms are listed so the check does not depend on timing.
